frames.note: Officer Reyes at Sam’s kitchen table
frames.caption: OFFICER REYES“I’m sorry. I don’t have good news. I don’t have any news.”

frames.caption: The township’s street map, 2009. And on tracing paper over it, the 1958 storm plan. The same blocks.

frames.name: 09-old-mill-court
frames.note: Old Mill Court from the head of the street
frames.caption: JAMIE“…What.”

frames.name: 10-dining-still
frames.note: The family at the table, not moving (through the window)
frames.caption: There’s still a little light.

frames.name: 11-dining-heads
frames.note: Their heads turned to you
frames.caption: There’s still a little light.

frames.name: 12-dining-glass
frames.note: The father at the glass (the hit)
frames.caption: There’s still a little light.

frames.caption: There’s still a little light.

frames.name: 14-reveal-landing
frames.note: It comes out onto the landing, looking at you
frames.caption: JAMIE“…Oh my god.”

frames.name: 15-reveal-stairs
frames.note: It comes down
frames.caption: JAMIE“Back. Back, back—”

frames.name: 16-stealth
frames.note: The stealth: it comes through the living room (seen from the dining room, past the foyer)
frames.caption: JAMIE“It goes round. Like a circle. When it’s on the other side, we go.”

frames.name: 19-giant

frames.caption: JAMIE“…What is that.”

frames.name: 20-chase
frames.note: The chase: it comes behind you on the court
frames.caption: JAMIE“It’s right behind us!”

frames.name: 21-grab
frames.note: At the oak: its hand on Jamie’s ankle
frames.caption: JAMIE“NO— NO NO—”

frames.name: 22-struggle
frames.note: Your hands on his wrist
frames.caption: JAMIE“DON’T LET GO— DON’T LET GO—”
